description: Inputs passed to the Pharos redemption-backed asset policy WASM at evaluation time

stablecoin_id.description: Canonical Pharos stablecoin identifier in ticker-issuer form, e.g. 'usdc-circle'.

transaction_amount_usd.description: USD notional of the intended position, checked against the redemption minimum and daily limit. CALLER-SUPPLIED and therefore NOT attested - see this pack's README. Defaults to 0 when omitted, which leaves the limit ratio undefined and fail-soft.
